critical_code_review_comments: engines/plan_cotes.py _find_chains: bands keyed by rounded int of (perp_pos/band_px) can split a valid chain across two adjacent bands if the perpendicular positions fall on a band boundary; consider a sliding-window grouping instead.

routes/plans_cotes.py: 502 raised on AI read errors but AI call has no timeout guard; on slow Gemini responses the client can hit CDN 60s bad-gateway before the endpoint answers (observed once during testing). Consider a soft timeout + async streaming/heartbeat.
CotesCheckPanel.jsx: tolCm defaults to '3' but if user clears it and validates empty, run() sends tol_cm: 0 while tol_pct fallback is 2 — inconsistent fallback; use `Number(tolCm) || 3` for parity.
